identities.essence: P = x*i + y*j + z*k. Any point is a weighted sum of basis directions.

identities.essence: Two grabbable vectors A and B yield a third vector A×B perpendicular to both, with magnitude equal to the parallelogram's area

identities.triggers: Aligning A and B collapses the result; opening them out grows the parallelogram and the perpendicular arrow; flipping order reverses sign
identities.emerges: A third dimension appears not as input but as result — the cross product reveals that two vectors imply a plane and its normal

identities.essence: velocity(p) = curl(noise(p)) = ∇×noise — the cross product of noise gradients; divergence-free by construction, particles flow forever without sinking or spreading
identities.desire: to watch 300 particles trace incompressible flow — swirling blue-to-white ribbons that never converge to a point because the math forbids it
identities.critical_parameter: flow_speed — at 0.1 particles drift in wide lazy loops; at 0.5 they spiral tight; the range shows how the same topology varies in tempo
identities.triggers: _ready → initialize particle positions randomly inside bounds → _process: per particle sample curl(noise(pos + time*flow_speed)) → integrate velocity → wrap bounds
identities.emerges: ribbon-like streaming — particles take different paths but never cross because divergence-free fields are globally consistent; no two particles occupy the same streamline
identities.needs: VR flow_speed slider [missing], bounds expansion [missing], particle count control [has via export]
identities.relationships: the incompressible fluid to VectorField's static field visualization; neighbor to noise_mixer (both use multi-octave noise structure); applies VectorCrossProduct in 3D
identities.truth: Curl noise is water without a container — it swirls forever because the mathematics of incompressibility has no room for endings.

identities.relationships: Foundation for work_energy_demo (W = F.d uses dot product). Feeds into hl_turret_vectors (FOV check = dot product). Contrasts with torque_demo (cross product).
identities.truth: The dot product is the question: how much do these two directions agree? The answer is a scalar — dimension collapses by design.

identities.critical_parameter: current_postulate — when it reaches 4 (the fifth), the entire color scheme shifts
identities.triggers: click/interact cycles postulates; reaching the fifth fires parallel_highlighted signal
identities.emerges: the dawning suspicion that the fifth postulate is not like the others — it can be denied
identities.needs: VR click interaction [has via mouse], XR grab interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: unlocks hyperbolic_surface and elliptic_surface (what happens when you deny the fifth); depends on angle_sum_triangle
identities.truth: the parallel postulate was assumed for two thousand years — its independence was the first crack in mathematical certainty

identities.essence: P ∨ ¬P — the law of excluded middle; Brouwer: "not always!"
identities.desire: see two glowing spheres (P and ¬P) with the disjunction between them, and toggle Brouwer's rejection
identities.critical_parameter: show_rejection — flips between classical acceptance and intuitionistic doubt
identities.triggers: VR slider toggles rejection mode; label text changes to reflect Brouwer's position
identities.emerges: the discomfort of undecidable propositions — some P genuinely cannot be decided
identities.needs: VR horizontal slider for rejection toggle [has]
identities.relationships: unlocks constructive_proof (if LEM is rejected, only constructive proofs survive); unlocks brouwer_choice_sequence; contrasts godel_statement_plaque (unprovable vs undecidable)
identities.truth: the law of excluded middle is not a law of logic — it is a philosophical commitment about what "true" means

identities.essence: Preset-driven or plan-driven facade composer — zones, bays, symmetry, and classical orders as architectural grammar
identities.desire: To let players compose their own facades from learned vocabulary: base, columns, openings, cornice, crown
identities.critical_parameter: preset — which architectural grammar (classical, gothic, palazzo, arcade, minimal) governs zone proportions
identities.triggers: Switching presets transforms the entire facade; changing bay_count alters rhythm; symmetry mode reshapes hierarchy
identities.emerges: Complete architectural facades from zone-based grammar rules
identities.needs: apply_grid_config [has], plan JSON support [has], FacadeComposer integration [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Synthesis artifact for facades sequence alongside facade_grammar_demo. Uses FacadeComposer part library.
identities.truth: Every facade is a sentence in an architectural grammar — the preset is the dialect, the parameters are the words.

identities.essence: 30 PSO particles on 3 switchable fitness landscapes — convergence (corporate), spread (ecological), novelty (artistic) — same agents, different power structures
identities.desire: to make the learner feel the moment the swarm reorganizes when you switch landscapes, and realize that "optimal" was never neutral
identities.critical_parameter: landscape_mode — switching it does not change the particles, only what counts as success, and the swarm obeys
identities.triggers: pressing CONVERGE makes the swarm collapse to center; pressing SPREAD makes it explode outward; pressing NOVELTY makes it seek edges and gaps
identities.emerges: the transition animations between landscapes — particles hesitate, reorient, sometimes oscillate before committing to the new definition of success
identities.needs: [has] three landscape buttons via ArtifactControls; [has] inertia slider; [has] terrain recolor; [missing] no history trace; no fitness graph
identities.relationships: placed in SwarmIntelligence_Particle_Swarm_Optimization alongside self_organizing_patterns; responds to the critical.md question "whose fitness function?"
identities.truth: the swarm always optimizes — the question is never whether to optimize but who wrote the objective function

identities.essence: a self-assembling 3D room that grows from a JSON floor plan — walls appear from cardinal adjacency, floors from mosaic patterns, and Italian facades clothe the inner surfaces without GridSystem dependency
identities.desire: to make a floor plan legible by walking it — the player inhabits the parsed structure and feels the difference between reading a room description and standing inside one
identities.critical_parameter: plan_path — the floor_plan.json determines every room boundary, wall orientation, and floor tile; the artifact is a JSON interpreter that builds space from grammar
identities.triggers: _ready() defers to _deferred_build(); apply_grid_config() triggers _load_and_build(); rooms constructed by iterating wall edges from room corner lists
identities.emerges: museum corridors with facade walls — a floor plan designed as data becomes an exhibition space that feels handmade; the grammar of rooms is the architecture
identities.needs: VR walking through each room [has — walkable static bodies]; wall preset switching [missing]; floor pattern variation per room [has via floor_plan.json]; apply_grid_config [has]
identities.relationships: spatial container for every museum map; pairs with FacadeComposer (wall surfaces) and MosaicFloorBuilder (floor tiles); governs Wallpaper_Groups_Gallery, Tile_Shapes_Gallery, Pixel_Art_Gallery
identities.truth: a room is not a boundary — it is a grammar of connections; floor_plan_space proves this by collapsing the difference between a JSON description and an inhabitable space

identities.essence: a procedural flower generator with VR sliders for petal count, length, width, curve, stem height, color hue, leaf count, and symmetry — turn one number and watch the entire anatomy respond
identities.desire: to make botanical morphospace walkable — petal count 5 is Fibonacci and feels "natural"; petal count 7 is rare and feels alien; the learner discovers the constraint without being told
identities.critical_parameter: petal count — Fibonacci numbers (3, 5, 8, 13) dominate in nature via golden angle packing; non-Fibonacci counts create visually distinct flowers that reveal the optimization pressure underlying plant form
identities.triggers: sliders connected to BotanicalFlower generator parameters; each slider_moved signal regenerates the mesh in real time; VR grip lets learners pull sliders while watching the flower reshape
identities.emerges: bilateral symmetry (orchid-style) creates forms that look purposeful and specialized; radial symmetry (daisy-style) looks more open and ancestral — toggling the symmetry parameter makes evolutionary divergence visible as a shape change
identities.needs: VR slider interaction [has]; apply_grid_config [has]; seed randomization per-load [missing — same seed each time]
identities.relationships: placed in morphogenesis map alongside turing_pattern_generator and queer_morphology_specimen; evolvingflowers (machinelearning) applies selection pressure to this same parameter space — flower_lab is manual exploration, evolvingflowers is evolution
identities.truth: the golden angle that makes Fibonacci petal counts dominant is not a design rule — it is what selection pressure looks like when the archive of solutions is the plant kingdom itself

identities.essence: F(x) = vector at every point. The field precedes the particle. Space is not empty.
identities.desire: To show the invisible. To make the learner see that empty space carries instructions.
identities.critical_parameter: Field type (gravity/coulomb/dipole/vortex). Each is a different spatial grammar.
identities.triggers: Type button → topology changes (radial vs rotational vs superposed), strength slider → arrows grow/shrink
identities.emerges: Superposition from dipole (two sources cancel/reinforce). Curl from vortex. Convergence from gravity.
identities.needs: VR type buttons [has], strength slider [has], equation labels [has]. Could use: particle tracer following field lines.
identities.relationships: Feeds into ForcesSystems (particles in fields). Contrasts with vector_fields (same concept, different rendering).
identities.truth: Motion is reading, not deciding. The field tells the particle where to go.

identities.essence: swing_plane(t) = initial_azimuth, earth_angle(t) += omega_earth * sin(latitude) * dt
identities.desire: Watch a pendulum draw rosette patterns as the Earth rotates beneath its fixed swing plane
identities.critical_parameter: earth_rotation_rate — controls precession speed (normally 360 deg/sidereal day * sin(lat))
identities.triggers: time drives both pendulum swing and Earth rotation; trail accumulates on canvas
identities.emerges: spirograph-like rosettes from the interaction of two independent rotational periods
identities.needs: VR observation of canvas [has], latitude control [missing]
identities.relationships: depends on inertial frame physics; contrasts with WavePaintings (inertial vs chaotic trace); unlocks rotating reference frame intuition
identities.truth: The pendulum does not rotate — the Earth rotates beneath it, and the trail is proof.

identities.essence: string(n+1) = replace_all(string(n), F, rule) — exponential rewriting made visible
identities.desire: To show the string before the tree — stacked generations revealing how F→F[+F]F[-F]F explodes
identities.critical_parameter: rule_to — the production rule determines the entire growth pattern of the string
identities.triggers: Each generation multiplies string length exponentially; truncation at 50000 chars shows the limit of display
identities.emerges: The realization that the tree was always in the string — geometry is just an interpretation of grammar
identities.needs: VR rule editor [missing], generation stepper [missing], Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: Paired with lsystem_tree (string vs geometry). Opens LSystems_Grammar_Lab.
identities.truth: The string is the structure — the tree is just one way to read it.

identities.essence: An inclined plane with tunable angle and friction — block slides when tan(θ) > μ, sticks when tan(θ) ≤ μ
identities.desire: To make the static-friction inequality visible as a threshold event — the slope where motion suddenly begins
identities.critical_parameter: friction_mu and ramp_angle_deg — their ratio decides whether the block holds or releases
identities.triggers: Low μ on any slope releases the block; high μ on shallow slope holds; the transition angle is arctan(μ)
identities.emerges: Friction reveals itself as a binary boundary — hold or slide — emerging from continuous parameters at a sharp threshold
identities.needs: angle and μ exposed as VR sliders [has], block placement and physics [has], grid config wiring [has]
identities.relationships: Companion to NewtonsLaws and bouncingball in forces/Newton's_Laws map. Tied to example_2_1 (drag) as resistance counterparts
identities.truth: Friction is not a force that always opposes motion — it is the contract surfaces sign before they decide whether to let go.

identities.essence: A glass vessel that no one designed — its shape is the record of gravity × pressure × duration × top pin
identities.desire: To stand next to a form that was not drawn but grown, and see on a label that the DNA is 3 forces and a clock
identities.critical_parameter: steps — the clock. Longer simulation = longer neck. Duration is the design parameter.
identities.triggers: Change stiffness → from rigid orb to collapsing teardrop. Change gravity direction → lopsided handcraft. Change pin width → bottle neck vs bowl mouth.
identities.emerges: An amphora, a bottle, a bowl, an urn — depending on force balance. Vessel type from force DNA.
identities.needs: VR scale (1.5m tall), Label3D for pedagogy, double-sided material so interior is visible
identities.relationships: Walkable twin of soft-body gallery gl01. Same DNA as trajectory-gallery tr01_unit_circle_spiral in spirit — both are "frozen processed form", but this one is 2D-surface instead of 1D-trajectory.
identities.truth: Duration is DNA. The clock is part of the genome.

identities.essence: B3/S23 — three neighbors birth, two or three survive. All complexity from this.
identities.desire: To be seeded and watched. To surprise with gliders, oscillators, guns.
identities.critical_parameter: The rule itself (B3/S23). The initial pattern. Speed of generations.
identities.triggers: GLIDER preset → traveling structure, GUN preset → infinite growth, RANDOM → emergent order from noise
identities.emerges: Gliders from local rules. Oscillators from symmetry. Guns from precise engineering. Computation from life.
identities.needs: VR speed slider [has], pattern buttons [has], clear/random [has]. Could use: rule editor (B/S variants).
identities.relationships: Unlocks cellularautomata sequence. Contrasts with continuous automata (CA_SoftRules). Feeds into Turing completeness.
identities.truth: Simple rules, applied everywhere simultaneously, produce complexity no one designed.

identities.essence: 8 sliders → CritterDNA → TreeMorphology.build() — design a tree's genome, watch it grow live
identities.desire: To sculpt a tree by tweaking its DNA — depth, forks, angle, taper, leaves, tropism, twist, arrangement
identities.critical_parameter: branch_angle (15-90°) — the single gene that most visibly transforms the tree's character
identities.triggers: Any slider move → debounced rebuild in 0.3s; Randomize → new genome; Plant → exports DNA for world placement
identities.emerges: The player becomes a breeder — intuition about which genes produce which forms develops through play
identities.needs: VR sliders [has, 8 sliders], push buttons [has, Random + Plant], Label3D [has via slider labels]
identities.relationships: Central to LSystems_Living. Uses CritterDNA and TreeMorphology systems. Bridges to evolution concepts.
identities.truth: A tree is eight numbers — change them and you are doing what evolution does, but with intention.

identities.essence: a 3D loss surface colored green (low) through yellow to red (high), with a white ball descending step by step along the negative gradient and leaving a blue trail of breadcrumbs
identities.desire: to make the invisible landscape of optimization tangible — the learner sees the ball get trapped in a local minimum and understands that optimization finds AN answer, not THE answer
identities.critical_parameter: learning_rate (0.08, range 0.005–0.3) — too large and the ball overshoots and oscillates; too small and convergence takes forever; the live slider makes this relationship visible immediately
identities.triggers: _ready builds surface (ImmediateMesh per frame), ball (SphereMesh), trail (capped array of breadcrumb spheres), VR control panel; _process() steps gradient descent every step_interval seconds
identities.emerges: when the ball converges, the frozen trail reveals the full descent path — starting position determines which local minimum is found; hitting reset with the same learning rate often finds a different minimum
identities.needs: VR learning rate slider [has via RackTemplates]; VR reset button [has]; apply_grid_config with explicit start_x/start_y [has]
identities.relationships: pairs with gradient_descent_visualization (simpler 2D version placed in ML_Gradient_Landscape); appears in machinelearning gallery; echoes loss_function_comparator (shows three loss functions side by side vs one animated descent)
identities.truth: gradient descent finds a nearby valley, not the deepest one — the starting point and learning rate determine which minimum you land in, making optimization an act of situated exploration rather than guaranteed discovery

identities.essence: Three L-system trees from three traditions — Lindenmayer 1968, Islamic geometric subdivision, Aboriginal kinship recursion — same engine, different grammars, different worlds
identities.desire: to make visible that every grammar encodes a worldview, and the question "whose grammar?" is always a political question
identities.critical_parameter: generation_depth — at depth 1 all three look alike; at depth 5 the cultural divergence becomes unmistakable
identities.triggers: increasing depth reveals that Lindenmayer's tree grows UP (botanical hierarchy), the Islamic pattern grows OUT (tiling symmetry), the kinship pattern grows AROUND (reciprocal branching)
identities.emerges: the viewer notices that "natural" branching is itself a cultural assumption — the L-system engine is neutral, but the axioms never are
identities.needs: [has] depth slider via ArtifactControls; [has] Label3D provenance annotations; [missing] no audio; no axiom editor
identities.relationships: placed in LSystems_Grammar_Lab alongside lsystem_editor and lsystem_tree; responds to the critical.md question "whose grammar?"
identities.truth: the grammar is never just math — it is always also a claim about what counts as growth

identities.essence: Turing's 1952 claim made walkable — two chemicals, two constants, nine ecologies
identities.desire: To make the argument of blog post #2 into something a person can stand inside
identities.critical_parameter: (F, K) — the entire content of each garden is encoded in two numbers
identities.triggers: The player walks between gardens and sees that identical math produces spots, stripes, mazes, coral, mitosis — nothing else changes
identities.emerges: The pedagogical punchline of reaction-diffusion. Pattern formation from local rules.
identities.needs: Enough space for 3×3 gardens. Labels at reading height. Walk paths between.
identities.relationships: Rd-family sibling of rd_coral_garden — this is the "all nine presets" teacher, that's the "one preset at full scale" artwork.
identities.truth: Everything here is (F, K). Nothing else changes. The rule is the thing.

identities.essence: harmonic_distance(a, b) = |shared_overtones(a, b)| — consonance as overtone overlap
identities.desire: Touch pitch nodes on a circle-of-fifths layout and see overtone relationships light up
identities.critical_parameter: base_octave — determines the frequency range for tone generation and overtone calculation
identities.triggers: selecting two notes computes shared overtone count and plays the interval
identities.emerges: consonance and dissonance as a visible network — more shared overtones = closer connection
identities.needs: VR touch on note nodes [has], audio playback [has]
identities.relationships: depends on circle-of-fifths layout; contrasts with chord_tension_spring (visual distance vs physical tension); unlocks harmonic series understanding
identities.truth: Consonance is the degree to which two pitches share the same overtone series.

identities.essence: D = T - P, cos(theta) = F.D/|F||D|, V = D-hat * speed, P' = P + V*dt. Nine vector operations in one machine.
identities.desire: To make every vector operation serve a purpose — subtraction finds the target, dot product checks the FOV, cross product aims the barrel. Nothing is abstract here.
identities.critical_parameter: field_of_view_degrees — the cone of awareness. Narrower FOV = more precise but more blind spots. The dot product threshold that separates "acquired" from "searching."
identities.triggers: Ball bounces → turret tracks, FOV check passes → laser activates and bullets fire, bullet hits ball → impulse + sparks + score, sliders → adjust FOV/rate/speed
identities.emerges: Leading the target — bullets aim at predicted position using ball velocity. Hit accuracy emerging from the interplay of fire rate, bullet speed, and ball chaos.
identities.needs: VR grabbable ball [has], FOV/fire-rate/speed sliders [has], spawn button [has]. Missing: multiple turrets with crossfire.
identities.relationships: Culmination of VectorApplied. Uses every operation taught in VectorBasics through VectorOperations. Contrasts with weather_vector_field (passive observation vs active targeting).
identities.truth: A turret does not think. It subtracts, normalizes, dots, crosses, and integrates. Intelligence is arithmetic applied with purpose.

identities.essence: y = K(x² - z²) — saddle surface with negative Gaussian curvature K < 0
identities.desire: touch a saddle and feel space curve outward — parallel lines diverge, triangles have angle sum < 180°
identities.critical_parameter: curvature — controls the severity of the saddle
identities.triggers: static geometry; the shape itself teaches by contradicting Euclidean intuition
identities.emerges: the realization that "straight" on a saddle looks curved from outside
identities.needs: VR controls [missing] — could add curvature_slider connection
identities.relationships: contrasts elliptic_surface (K>0, lines converge); depends on curvature_slider; paired with poincare_disk (same geometry, different model)
identities.truth: on a negatively curved surface, there are infinitely many parallel lines through any point — the fifth postulate fails spectacularly

identities.essence: Two procedural TwoBoneIK3D arms tracing figure-8 patterns — inverse kinematics as embodiment negotiation
identities.desire: To show how VR arms work: skeleton, bone chain, target marker, and the solver that bends joints to reach
identities.critical_parameter: upper_arm_length + lower_arm_length — the reach envelope; targets beyond this sum reveal the solver limits
identities.triggers: Figure-8 targets push arms through full range; near-limit reaches show elbow flip; symmetric motion reveals bilateral IK
identities.emerges: Fluid arm motion from a two-bone chain solver — the same algorithm that connects floating VR hands to shoulders
identities.needs: Procedural skeleton [has], animated targets [has], joint markers [has], VR hand tracking [missing — demo only]
identities.relationships: Core artifact in BodyProg_Arms. Bridges body progression and spatial algorithms. Uses Skeleton3D + SkeletonIK3D.
identities.truth: The arm does not move — the target moves, and the arm solves for how to follow.

identities.essence: a 3D billboard that displays a curated PNG
identities.desire: every starred /dna finding is placeable, even when its grammar

identities.essence: SoftBody3D with spring-mass physics — stiffness, damping, and pressure_coefficient govern deformation response
identities.desire: to let you poke a translucent cube and feel its resistance change under your hands as you drag sliders between rigid and liquid
identities.critical_parameter: stiffness — at 0 the cube collapses into a puddle, at 1 it barely yields, the sweet spot between is where jelly lives
identities.triggers: hand collision with the SoftBody3D surface causes real-time vertex displacement; pressure slider inflates or deflates the volume
identities.emerges: at low stiffness and high pressure the cube becomes a breathing balloon; at low pressure it drapes over the pedestal like cloth
identities.needs: slider_horizontal [has] (stiffness, damping, pressure); push_button [has] (color cycle, reset); Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: introduces spring-mass foundation before cloth_straps and soft_mushroom; contrasts with rounded_softbody_test which adds strain visualization
identities.truth: elasticity is not a property of the object — it is a negotiation between the object's internal forces and whatever touches it

identities.essence: z = z^2 + c per pixel (GPU shader), c controlled by VR sliders. 6 famous presets: Dendrite, San Marco, Rabbit, Spiral, Dragon, Douady.
identities.desire: To be tuned — two sliders map to the real and imaginary parts of c, and every tiny adjustment reshapes the entire fractal
identities.critical_parameter: c (complex) — moving c by 0.01 can change a connected dendrite into disconnected dust; the boundary is the Mandelbrot set
identities.triggers: VR sliders → c_real/c_imag update → shader recomputes instantly; preset buttons → jump to famous Julia sets
identities.emerges: The relationship between c and topology — learners discover that c values inside the Mandelbrot give connected Julia sets
identities.needs: VR sliders [has], preset buttons [has], zoom [has via keyboard]. Mandelbrot overlay showing c position [missing]
identities.relationships: GPU sibling to julia_set (MultiMesh CPU); paired with mandelbrot_dive for the full Mandelbrot-Julia duality
identities.truth: The Julia set explorer is a microscope for the Mandelbrot set — each c value reveals one of infinitely many fractal universes.

identities.essence: library[i] = registry.artifacts[i].scene — a physical index of computational objects
identities.desire: stand before a wall of everything the system can make, organized and labeled
identities.critical_parameter: the collection key — one word selects which registry to display
identities.triggers: apply_grid_config reads collection, loads registry, builds wall of instanced scenes
identities.emerges: a periodic table for any domain — shaders, primitives, patterns, hazards, math objects
identities.truth: a library is not the objects — it is the act of organizing them so they can be found

identities.essence: Lindenmayer 1968 plant rendered at VR scale — F→F[+F]F[-F]F as volume, not line
identities.desire: To stand next to a tree that is entirely rule-generated and see every branch as an oriented tube
identities.critical_parameter: angle_deg — the classical 25.7° is one of Lindenmayer's own values; vary it and the plant becomes a different species
identities.triggers: Change rules → different plant. Change iterations → sapling to full tree. Change angle → palm to pine to bush.
identities.emerges: A tree you can circle. Branch tapering from turtle width_shrink visible as you approach.
identities.needs: Label3D for pedagogy. Enough space to walk around.
identities.relationships: Sibling of lsystem_tree (line render) and ls03_classic_tree (gallery artifact). Uses the same DNA that seeds gg_ls01_plant_chandelier, sb_ls02_plant_wind_collapse, ps_ls01_bauhaus_tree.
identities.truth: No hand-placed branches. The string decided where every tube goes.

identities.essence: a curated lsystem composition placed in a VR scene
identities.desire: every starred lsystem finding becomes a walkable tree, not a flat snapshot
identities.critical_parameter: config_path — the JSON config that drives the rewrite + walk
identities.triggers: instantiation; apply_grid_config rebuilds with new config
identities.emerges: gallery-curated branching forms inhabit maps
identities.needs: a config at config_path, lsystem_grammar scripts present
identities.relationships: same build code as dna_workstation._build_lsystem and render_lsystem.gd
identities.truth: the build function is the truth; everything else is wrapping

identities.essence: F → F+RF-FF-FR+F, R → RFRFRF — corridor grammar with room markers at 90° turns
identities.desire: To generate a dungeon you can look down on — corridors and rooms from two rewriting rules
identities.critical_parameter: iterations — controls dungeon complexity from a single corridor to a labyrinthine floor plan
identities.triggers: Iteration 1 → simple L-shaped corridor; iteration 4 → dense maze with many rooms and walled passages
identities.emerges: Spatial variety from two rules — rooms appear at grammatical intersections, not placed by a designer
identities.needs: VR iteration control [missing], Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: Feeds into LSystems_Architecture. Contrasts with CityGenerator (2D plan vs 3D growth). Bridges to proceduralgeneration.
identities.truth: Two rules and a turtle — the dungeon writes itself.

identities.essence: axiom → rules → string → turtle(F, +, -, [, ]) → line geometry — the full L-system pipeline interactively
identities.desire: To be played with — slide between Koch, Sierpinski, Dragon, Plant, Bush, Fern, and Binary Tree in real time
identities.critical_parameter: preset (0-6) — seven fundamentally different grammars, each a different visual universe
identities.triggers: Changing angle while keeping rules → same grammar, different geometry; generation slider → growth stages
identities.emerges: The insight that one renderer + different rules = infinite variety — grammar IS the design tool
identities.needs: VR preset slider [has], generation slider [has], angle slider [has], Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: Central to LSystems_Grammar_Lab. Feeds into lsystem_tree (fixed vs interactive). Pairs with fractal_lsystem_string.
identities.truth: Seven presets, one turtle — the grammar is the artist.

identities.essence: F → F[+F]F[-F]F at 25.7° — the classic Lindenmayer plant in one rule
identities.desire: To stand as the canonical L-system tree — the simplest grammar that produces a convincing plant
identities.critical_parameter: base_angle (25.7°) — Lindenmayer's original angle, balancing spread and density perfectly
identities.triggers: Changing iterations → sapling to forest giant; adjusting angle → palm to pine to bush
identities.emerges: Branching depth creates a brown-to-green gradient — trunk becomes canopy through recursion alone
identities.needs: VR iteration/angle controls [missing], Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: Appears in LSystems_Grammar_Lab, LSystems_Growth, and LSystems_Living. The reference tree for the whole sequence.
identities.truth: One rule, one angle, one axiom — a tree grows.

identities.essence: λ(a,b) = (1/N)Σ log|r(1-2x)|, alternating r between a and b in AABB pattern. Stable regions blue (λ<0), chaotic regions yellow/red (λ>0), boundary black.
identities.desire: to lay alien calligraphy on the floor — the Lyapunov landscape is a map of two parameters against each other, where the boundary between order and chaos draws itself
identities.critical_parameter: PATTERN array — changing "AABB" to "AB" or "AAAB" morphs the fractal into different alien script, same math, different handwriting
identities.triggers: _ready → _generate_texture → per-pixel (a,b) iterate WARMUP+COMPUTE logistic maps → sum log|r(1-2x)| → color blue/black/red by sign
identities.emerges: the thin black curves of λ≈0 — the exact edge where each parameter combination teeters between repeating and diverging, drawn without any explicit curve equation
identities.needs: VR parameter walk [missing], PATTERN selector [missing], floor scale control [missing]
identities.relationships: sibling to cantor_set (both explore what zero looks like); twin to fractal_clouds (both render a scalar field as visual texture); foundation for strange_attractors
identities.truth: The Lyapunov fractal does not show space — it shows the stability of time. Every pixel is a different universe asking: does this rule converge, or does it spiral into chaos?

identities.essence: z = z² + c, iterated. Escape or stay forever. The boundary between these is infinitely complex.
identities.desire: To be zoomed into. To reveal that every magnification contains the whole. To never end.
identities.critical_parameter: Zoom depth. At 10x you see the cardioid. At 10000x you see seahorses. At 10^15 you see copies of yourself.
identities.triggers: Zoom slider → deeper structure, palette switch → different beauty from same math, auto-dive → the infinite descent
identities.emerges: Self-similarity from iteration. The Mandelbrot set from the simplest possible complex map. Beauty from z²+c.
identities.needs: VR zoom slider [has], palette selector [has], auto-dive [has]. Could use: Julia set toggle (show connected set for current c).
identities.relationships: Contains all Julia sets as slices. Connects to fractals sequence. Demonstrates escape-time algorithms.
identities.truth: The simplest equation in complex dynamics produces the most complex object in mathematics.

identities.essence: event -> destroy(DarkSphere) + reveal(Rainbow) — one-shot state transition from darkness to color
identities.desire: to punch a block and break the darkness open, rainbow erupting where void used to be
identities.critical_parameter: _activated — boolean gate that ensures the transformation happens exactly once, making it feel like a revelation
identities.triggers: NextCube.next_requested signal or player body collision — either path leads to the same irreversible moment
identities.emerges: the elastic tween on the rainbow and the back-ease shrink on the sphere create a visual call-and-response that feels choreographed
identities.needs: NextCube signal [has]; DarkSphere reference [has]; player collision [has]; VR grab [missing]
identities.relationships: depends on dark_sphere (destroys it); depends on NextCube (trigger); rainbow echoes the rainbow artifact's color bands
identities.truth: joy is not the presence of color — it is the moment darkness becomes color

identities.essence: a mesh-grammar config rendered as a placeable Node3D
identities.desire: petals, mushrooms, towers, coral — gallery findings as 3D objects
identities.critical_parameter: config_path — the JSON config (seed + rules + generations)

identities.essence: total(p) = Σ(i=0..octaves) persistence^i * noise(base_frequency * lacunarity^i * p) — each octave doubles frequency, halves amplitude, adds finer detail

identities.emerges: altitude-colored terrain — the low-frequency base octave creates large valleys, high-frequency octaves texture the ridges; color reveals the hierarchy
identities.needs: real-time slider regeneration [missing], octave count control [has via export]
identities.relationships: 2D cross-section of what fractal_clouds does in 3D volume; explains the parameter space that perlin_terrain_sculptor sculpts in; parent concept to lyapunov_fractal
identities.truth: Complexity is layered repetition. The same simple wave, run at four frequencies simultaneously, looks like land.

identities.essence: voxel_on[pos] = noise_3d(pos × frequency) > threshold — a 24³ grid that thresholds Perlin noise, with VR sliders broadcasting changes to linked voxelnoise receivers

identities.desire: see two basis states |0⟩ and |1⟩ breathe in and out of opacity while the superposition sphere pulses between them
identities.critical_parameter: _speed — controls the oscillation frequency between basis states
identities.triggers: VR slider adjusts oscillation speed; opacity of |0⟩ and |1⟩ spheres anti-correlate continuously
identities.emerges: the visual proof that superposition is not flickering between states — it is occupying both simultaneously
identities.needs: VR horizontal slider for speed [has]
identities.relationships: paired with schrodinger_box (abstract vs physical superposition); contrasts florensky_sphere (quantum vs paraconsistent logic)
identities.truth: superposition is not uncertainty about which state the system is in — it is the system genuinely being in both

identities.essence: waveform(t) = sum(amplitude[n] * sin(n * fundamental * t)) — additive synthesis with audio
identities.desire: Sculpt timbre by adjusting harmonic sliders and hearing the result immediately in VR
identities.critical_parameter: fundamental_freq — sets the pitch; all harmonics are integer multiples of this
identities.triggers: slider movement changes harmonic amplitudes; morph_speed controls preset transitions
identities.emerges: the sound of mathematics — square waves, saw waves, clarinet, all from the same formula
identities.needs: VR sliders for 8 harmonics [has], preset buttons [has], audio output [has]
identities.relationships: depends on AudioStreamGenerator; contrasts with additive_wave_demo (audible vs visual synthesis); unlocks timbre-as-spectrum
identities.truth: Timbre is the harmonic fingerprint of a sound — the same note on different instruments differs only in overtone amplitudes.

identities.essence: Three animated tracking points (head + two hands) driving real-time torso orientation estimation with visual feedback
identities.desire: To show that the VR body is inferred, not measured: three points in space produce a torso through computation
identities.critical_parameter: head_weight — how much head direction vs hand midpoint determines torso facing
identities.triggers: Hands moving apart widens shoulder markers; head turning reorients forward arrow; asymmetric positions tilt the torso
identities.emerges: A believable torso from three floating points — the body filling in gaps that sensors never measured
identities.needs: Animated tracking points [has], shoulder markers [has], forward arrow [has], connection lines [has], VR input [missing — demo]
identities.relationships: Fourth artifact in bodyprogression. Follows ik_arm_demo, precedes dress_selector. Uses 3-point estimation.
identities.truth: The body is not given — it is the computation that fills the space between what the sensors actually see.

identities.essence: CPU Gray-Scott simulation — du/dt = Du*laplacian(u) - u*v^2 + f*(1-u), dv/dt = Dv*laplacian(v) + u*v^2 - (k+f)*v — iterated steps_per_frame times per frame on a 2D grid
identities.desire: to hold a Turing pattern in your hands and twist the feed/kill knobs until you find the boundary where spots become stripes become mazes
identities.critical_parameter: feed/kill ratio — the two parameters together define a 2D phase space; each preset (Spots, Stripes, Maze, Mitosis, Coral, Waves) is a point in that space
identities.triggers: VR sliders for feed, kill, and preset selection; reset button re-seeds the simulation; keyboard 1-6 for direct preset selection
identities.emerges: the laplacian coupling between neighboring cells means local perturbations propagate as waves — pattern is not local but a property of the entire coupled field
identities.needs: slider_horizontal [has] (preset, feed, kill); push_button [has] (reset); Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: CPU complement to reaction_diffusion's GPU shader approach; both demonstrate Turing's morphogenesis paper in different implementations
identities.truth: pattern emerges from the ratio of two diffusion rates — not from a template, not from a gene, but from the mathematics of how fast activation outruns inhibition

identities.essence: C = A + B. Head-to-tail construction. The parallelogram law.
identities.desire: To let the learner grab two arrows and watch a third arrow appear — the sum — making addition tangible rather than symbolic.
identities.critical_parameter: The angle between vector_a and vector_b. Parallel vectors add magnitudes; perpendicular vectors add by Pythagoras; opposed vectors cancel.
identities.triggers: Handle drag → resultant updates, preset buttons → snap to orthogonal/acute/3D configurations, ghost arrows → parallelogram appears
identities.emerges: The parallelogram from ghost arrows. The triangle inequality (|A+B| <= |A|+|B|) becomes visible without being stated.
identities.needs: VR grabbable handles [has], preset buttons [has]. Missing: slider to animate blending between A and B.
identities.relationships: Prerequisite for combined_forces_demo (force superposition is vector addition). Pairs with vector_subtraction_demo (inverse operation).
identities.truth: Addition is geometry, not arithmetic. Two directions become one.

identities.essence: A + B = C at body scale. You ARE inside the vector space.
identities.desire: Walk along the X-axis to feel the X-component. Addition becomes spatial, not symbolic.
identities.critical_parameter: Grid size vs vector length — vectors must fit inside the walkable volume.
identities.triggers: Handle grab → vectors update, preset buttons → snap configurations
identities.emerges: The parallelogram from ghost arrows. Component projections along axes.
identities.needs: VR grabbable handles [has], preset buttons [has], 3D grid [has]
identities.relationships: Room-scale version of vector_addition_demo. Pairs with basis_vectors_rig.
identities.truth: You don't observe vector addition. You stand inside it.

identities.essence: Side-by-side display of a vector V and its normalized form V̂ = V/|V|, sharing direction but with unit length
identities.desire: To make the difference between direction and magnitude visible — same arrow, two scales, one geometric purpose
identities.critical_parameter: input vector magnitude — large input compresses to unit, tiny input expands; both arrive at length 1
identities.triggers: Any direction reads, only magnitude is removed; zero vector is the singular case where normalization fails
identities.emerges: Direction as a separable property of vectors — a vector is a magnitude and a unit, and unit vectors compose direction-only spaces
identities.needs: vector input controls [has], live normalization computation [has], unit-circle/sphere reference [has]
identities.relationships: Companion to vector_magnitude_demo (already voiced) in forces/Combat_Arena. Foundation for aim and direction artifacts
identities.truth: Normalization is the act of forgetting how far — keeping only which way. It is direction extracted from the vector.

identities.essence: reflect(A) = A - 2(A.n)n. Projection strips a component; reflection mirrors through a plane. Both are dot-product machines.
identities.desire: To let the learner tilt a plane and watch a vector bounce — making the law of reflection a spatial experience, not a memorized rule.
identities.critical_parameter: The normal vector direction. It defines the plane. Tilting it changes what "perpendicular" means and rewrites both projection and reflection.
identities.triggers: Handle drag (A or n) → five arrows update simultaneously (A, n, projection, reflection, normal component), preset buttons → floor/wall/45deg/glance
identities.emerges: Angle of incidence equaling angle of reflection — visible in the symmetry of A and its reflection about the translucent plane. Glancing angles produce near-tangent reflections.
identities.needs: VR grabbable handles [has], preset buttons [has], translucent plane mesh [has]. Missing: bouncing ball animation following the reflection path.
identities.relationships: Extends dot_product_projector (projection uses dot product). Feeds into normal_force_demo (force decomposition onto surface normal). Used by every billiard/bounce in the engine.
identities.truth: A mirror does not reverse left and right. It reverses the component perpendicular to its surface. Reflection is subtraction, twice.

identities.essence: for each Z-cluster of wall cubes, overlay all 6 faces with wallpaper_tile shader using a unique wallpaper group + neon palette + procedural domain texture
identities.desire: to walk through a tunnel where every surface — walls, ceiling, floor — displays a different wallpaper group in neon color, immersing the body in mathematical symmetry
identities.critical_parameter: cluster_size — cubes per Z-row before advancing to next wallpaper group; controls how much space each symmetry type occupies
identities.triggers: on _ready, discovers GridSystem wall cubes, groups by Z, assigns wallpaper groups cyclically; builds ceiling and floor pattern cubes to close the tunnel
identities.emerges: the combination of 8 neon palettes, 6 pattern types (blocks/stripes/diagonal/concentric/checker/cross), and 17 wallpaper groups produces a corridor that never visually repeats
identities.needs: [missing] no VR sliders or buttons — configuration only through apply_grid_config; the gallery is a walk-through experience, not an interactive station
identities.relationships: the architectural showcase complement to pattern_maker_station (interactive editing vs passive immersion); uses same wallpaper_tile.gdshader
identities.truth: symmetry is not decoration — it is the mathematical structure that determines how a small truth propagates through space

identities.essence: Grid wrapper instantiating WaterFlowers — procedural blooms floating on Gerstner wave physics simulation
identities.desire: To bring together botany and physics: flowers drift on mathematically accurate ocean waves in real time
identities.critical_parameter: wave_strength — how tall the Gerstner waves grow; controls the drama of the floating motion
identities.triggers: More flowers produce denser garden; stronger waves produce dramatic bobbing; drift speed scatters blooms
identities.emerges: A living water garden where procedural flowers respond to procedural ocean — two systems coupled through physics
identities.needs: apply_grid_config [has], flower count control [has], wave parameters [has], VR observation [has]
identities.relationships: Fourth artifact in flowers sequence (Flower_Physics). Bridges botanical generation with physics simulation.
identities.truth: The flower does not float — the wave lifts it, and the wave does not know the flower is there.

identities.essence: a 16×16 floor panel solved by Wave Function Collapse — each cell's terrain type (ground, water, sand, grass, stone, path) was chosen by constraint propagation, not random assignment
identities.desire: to show that local rules produce global coherence — the mosaic looks designed because every tile honored its neighbors' constraints, and the result is the only map that could have existed
identities.critical_parameter: grid_size (16) and the adjacency rules — water may only neighbor water or sand, never stone; changing one adjacency rule cascades through every cell that depended on it
identities.triggers: _ready() calls _solve_wfc() which runs constraint propagation until every cell collapses to one tile type, then renders via ArrayMesh pixel geometry
identities.emerges: landscape-like patterns without a landscape designer — rivers, shores, and paths appear because ecology IS a local-constraint system; the algorithm finds the same shapes biology does
identities.needs: VR standing on the mosaic [has — StaticBody3D]; live re-solving with player input [missing]; grid_size variation [missing]; apply_grid_config [has]
identities.relationships: placed with pattern_tile_puzzle and array_carpet — the three form a progression: draw (puzzle) → repeat (carpet) → constrain (WFC); each is a different theory of pattern formation
identities.truth: Wave Function Collapse is not random — it is maximum constraint at every step; the map it produces is the only map that could exist given its adjacency rules, which makes it identical to how cities grow

identities.essence: four reading panels arranged in a room, each carrying one fragment of an argument — On Gödel, On Margins, On the Commons, On Incompleteness — each ending in a cross-reference to the next, cycling without resolution
identities.desire: to enact incompleteness architecturally — you can read all four panels and still not reach the thesis, because the thesis IS the walking; a wiki is not a system but a ledger of incompletenesses that route
identities.critical_parameter: the cross-reference footer on each panel ("→ see EAST · On Margins") — this directed cycle prevents any single panel from being a conclusion; removing it would make it just four quotes
identities.triggers: _ready builds panel with fragment from _fragment_key or cell-position hash; _populate_from_fragment() sets title/body/cf/footer and tints the panel per fragment color; apply_grid_config accepts explicit #fragment:NORTH|EAST|SOUTH|WEST
identities.emerges: walking the four panels in order returns you to the starting point — WEST cross-references NORTH, closing the loop; incompleteness becomes experiential rather than declarative
identities.needs: apply_grid_config [has]; VR walk-through with panels in cardinal positions so the cross-references are spatially directional [missing — any arrangement works but cardinal is the intent]
identities.relationships: pairs with situated_readout (same postfoundationscrisis map series); echoes godel_statement_plaque (declarative) — wiki_fragment makes the same point architectural; the 47/62/84/103 editor counts create a sense of accumulated, contested knowledge
identities.truth: what one panel cannot hold, the ledger can — a wiki is not consistent, it is corrigible, and corrigibility is more honest than completeness

identities.essence: for each pixel: F1=nearest seed distance, F2=second nearest; render (F2-F1) → bright thin edges on dark cell interiors; Voronoi tessellation as texture
identities.desire: to make cellular structure visible — the same distance function that divides a map into postal zones also generates skin texture, stone, and cell membranes
identities.critical_parameter: num_seeds — few seeds create large cells (stone slab); many seeds create tight cells (skin, scales); the count IS the cell density
identities.triggers: _ready → scatter num_seeds at random positions → per pixel: compute distances to all seeds → sort → F1=first, F2=second → color = clamp(F2-F1)
identities.emerges: cells with razor-thin bright edges — the Voronoi tessellation drawn not by geometry but by the distance census every pixel takes of its neighbors
identities.needs: VR seed count slider [missing], animated seed movement [missing], F-value selector [missing]
identities.relationships: inverse of noise_mixer (Worley uses distance, Perlin uses gradient); complement to lyapunov_fractal (both show structure in 2D parameter fields)
identities.truth: Worley noise is a democracy — every pixel votes for its nearest neighbor, and the visible borders are where two candidates tie.

identities.essence: y(t) = A * sin(2*PI*f*t) — simple harmonic motion along the vertical axis
identities.desire: Watch a cube bounce on a vertical rail, feeling the simplest possible oscillation
identities.critical_parameter: frequency — controls how fast the cube oscillates up and down
identities.triggers: time drives continuous sine evaluation; amplitude and frequency adjustable
identities.emerges: the most elemental wave visualization — one axis, one sine, one cube
identities.needs: VR observation [has], amplitude/frequency sliders [missing], ghost trail [has]
identities.relationships: depends on basic sine function; contrasts with oscillation_controlled_cube (single vs multi-axis oscillation); unlocks y=sin(t) intuition
identities.truth: y = A*sin(2*pi*f*t) is the simplest sentence in the language of oscillation.

identities.essence: catalog[category][sound_key] -> preview(parameters) -> waveform display
identities.desire: Browse and audition a library of synthesized sounds on a VR tablet interface
identities.critical_parameter: sound_key — selects which synthesis algorithm to preview
identities.triggers: touch-selecting a sound generates audio and visualizes its waveform
identities.emerges: a sonic encyclopedia — every sound becomes a specimen you can examine and compare
identities.needs: VR touch screen [has], category filtering [has], waveform visualization [has]
identities.relationships: depends on AudioCatalogDataProvider; contrasts with SoundscapeRadioRack (individual sounds vs ambient streams); unlocks sound literacy
identities.truth: A sound catalog is a periodic table of timbres, each defined by its synthesis recipe.

identities.essence: AudioServer.get_bus_peak_volume_left/right -> waveform display
identities.desire: See the audio bus activity rendered as a real-time waveform monitor in VR
identities.critical_parameter: audio_bus — selects which audio bus to monitor
identities.triggers: auto_connect finds and binds to the audio system on ready
identities.emerges: visual feedback loop between what you hear and what you see
identities.needs: VR viewport display [has], bus selection [missing]
identities.relationships: depends on WaveformDisplay 2D scene; contrasts with dual_display_test (monitoring vs spectrum analysis); unlocks audio debugging in VR
identities.truth: Sound is invisible force; the monitor makes the waveform a visible object.

identities.essence: station = floor(angle / station_width), clarity = 1 - |offset| / threshold
identities.desire: Turn a physical wheel in VR to tune between soundscape radio stations
identities.critical_parameter: station_width (degrees per station) — determines tuning precision
identities.triggers: wheel rotation angle maps to station index; proximity to center determines signal clarity
identities.emerges: static noise between stations, clean signal at center — analog radio metaphor
identities.needs: VR hinge wheel [has], volume wheel [has]
identities.relationships: depends on SciFiLoFiSoundscape presets; contrasts with audio_catalog_tablet (browsing vs tuning); unlocks ambient audio curation
identities.truth: Every frequency band is a station; tuning is selecting which resonance to amplify.

identities.essence: 2D boolean array[track][step] where each 1 triggers a sound at BPM-derived intervals — a physical 16-step × 4-track drum machine rendered in 3D, where toggling a cell means "play this sound at this beat"
identities.desire: to feel rhythm as a 2D array — to toggle cells on a physical 16-step grid and hear your pattern play back, discovering that a drum pattern is just a boolean matrix traversed column by column at a fixed tempo
identities.critical_parameter: sound_preset — determines which 4 sounds fill the tracks; "house" gives TR909 kick + M1 piano + hi-hat + TB303 acid bass, turning the array into a culturally specific musical grammar
identities.triggers: BPM controls the column-advance rate; step_triggered(track, step) fires on every active cell; the "house" preset carries the cultural memory of 1990s house music into the abstract array demonstration
identities.emerges: students discover that musical style is a distribution over the boolean array — house music has kick on beats 1&3, and this pattern emerges from which cells are toggled; the array encodes cultural knowledge
identities.needs: SequencerUI [has via SubViewport2Din3D]; AudioSynthesizer [has]; CustomSoundGenerator [has]; VR interaction for toggling cells [has]; BPM control [has]; no VR slider_horizontal [missing — uses internal UI]
identities.relationships: paired with StandaloneDiscoFloor in Tutorial_Disco for the full arrays-as-music synthesis; house preset references Gypsy Woman/Crystal Waters production style; connects to step sequencer in audio rack
identities.truth: a step sequencer is a for-loop over time — the array of steps is executed rhythmically, and music is what happens when a boolean array runs at 120 BPM

identities.essence: proximity = clamp(1 - distance/max_distance, 0, 1), smoothed per frame
identities.desire: Move through space and hear sound respond to your distance from a target
identities.critical_parameter: max_distance — defines the radius of sonic influence
identities.triggers: continuous distance measurement between listener and target drives proximity signal
identities.emerges: spatial audio awareness — sound as a field you move through, not a point you trigger
identities.needs: VR player position tracking [has], target node reference [has]
identities.relationships: depends on spatial distance calculation; contrasts with MelodyChaser3D (continuous field vs discrete triggers); unlocks proximity-based audio
identities.truth: Sound in space is a field of intensities that the body samples by moving through it.

identities.essence: grabbable board with paginated text/code content, proximity reveal shader, VR page-flip via trigger/grip
identities.desire: learner picks up a physical document and reads it in VR — code and theory delivered as held artifact
identities.critical_parameter: description_sets — the array of page strings; empty means no content, one means single-page
identities.triggers: picking up → shows page navigation hint; trigger/grip buttons flip pages; drop → awards XP/SP
identities.emerges: reading as an embodied act — you must hold the clipboard to read it, creating intentional engagement
identities.needs: [has grabbable GrabPlane [has], has VR trigger/grip page flip [has], has Label3D page number [has]]
identities.relationships: content loaded via apply_grid_config (tutorial ID or page keys); used in nearly every map
identities.truth: a text in VR is not passive — the learner must pick it up, hold it, and navigate it with their hands

identities.essence: a 3D placard that pulls tutorial text from a library by ID — the in-world reader for code / explanation content
identities.desire: bring authored text into the scene without breaking immersion — readable, formatted, addressable by name
identities.critical_parameter: current_tutorial_id — picks which entry from tutorial_text.json is shown
identities.triggers: _ready() instantiates TutorialTextLibrary and waits a frame to locate the RichTextLabel inside the Viewport2Din3D
identities.emerges: a readable in-VR text panel that the map-author addresses by tt:<name> tokens
identities.needs: TutorialTextLibrary [present]; Viewport2Din3D child [scene-required]; rich text label resolution [present, deferred]
identities.relationships: clipboard/context companion to science_screen (in-world readout) and reader_table (extended reading); the placement-by-token side of the tutorial-content pipeline
identities.truth: A tutorial is a placement-of-words. The library holds the words, the placard holds the placement — separating them lets the same text appear in many maps.

identities.essence: on_area_entered -> set_shader_param("is_touched", true); after cooldown -> false — a reflective sphere that glows when touched, then cools down on a timer
identities.desire: to reach out in VR and touch the crystal ball — to see it light up in response and wait for it to reset, a minimal call-and-response between hand and object
identities.critical_parameter: cooldown_time — 3.5 seconds of glow before the sphere resets; the duration of magical contact
identities.triggers: Area3D.on_area_entered activates the shader's is_touched parameter; Timer.timeout deactivates it; material is duplicated on _ready for independent shader state
identities.emerges: the simplest possible VR interaction — touch and glow — creates a ritual quality when placed in F26_Portal_Chamber as the threshold object
identities.needs: [has] Area3D collision detection for VR hand interaction; [missing] no sliders, no buttons — the hand itself is the only control
identities.relationships: the focal artifact for F26_Portal_Chamber (portal/threshold space); a primitive interaction model that contrasts with complex multi-slider artifacts
identities.truth: the crystal ball does not predict — it responds; and the shortest possible feedback loop between body and light is already enough to feel presence

identities.essence: MultiMesh of (width × depth) flat tile instances, each independently colored per-step by pattern functions (checkerboard, wave, spiral, snake, rainbow) driven by animation_step advancing every pattern_speed seconds
identities.desire: to stand on a floor that is computing — to feel the checkerboard pattern as an array of booleans where (x+z)%2 determines your tile's color, or to watch a snake pattern trace a Hamiltonian path through the grid beneath your feet
identities.critical_parameter: pattern_speed — at 0.08s the animation is continuous and hypnotic; at 0.5s individual tiles visibly switch state one by one; this controls whether the floor reads as a pattern or as a computation
identities.triggers: start_disco() begins animation; pattern_duration seconds elapse → next Pattern enum value; 10 patterns cycle automatically; walkable=true adds collision geometry so players can actually walk on the tiles
identities.emerges: when 12×12 tiles animate together at disco speed, individual pattern logic (i.e., a simple modulo or sin function) becomes a physically immersive audiovisual experience — the mathematics disappears into sensation
identities.needs: MultiMeshInstance3D [has]; collision for walking [has when walkable=true]; auto-cycling patterns [has]; DiscoSequencerBridge [has as sibling for audio sync]; no VR slider to control pattern or speed [missing]
identities.relationships: paired with StepSequencer in Tutorial_Disco for the "arrays as music" synthesis; uses DiscoSequencerBridge for audio coupling; standalone variant of DiscoFloorController which requires GridSystem
identities.truth: a disco floor is a 2D array of light values updated over time — every club floor is a physical proof that arrays can be felt, not just computed

identities.essence: height(x,z) = FastNoiseLite.get_noise_2d(x × noise_scale, z × noise_scale) × height_scale — fractal noise as a walkable terrain substrate
identities.desire: to walk across a landscape that is simultaneously random and smooth — to feel that the ground underfoot is coherent without being designed
identities.critical_parameter: noise_scale — at low values the terrain is a gentle undulation; at high values it becomes violently jagged; the sweet spot is where walking feels organic
identities.triggers: changing octaves changes how many scales of detail are superimposed; the organic green material reinforces the disruption aesthetic of non-Euclidean space
identities.emerges: the TopologySpace base class provides the mesh infrastructure; the noise generates height variation that makes this space feel like resistance — harder to traverse than a flat grid
identities.needs: no VR controls [missing]; all parameters are export-only; the terrain is generated once at startup and does not update dynamically [has]
identities.relationships: extends TopologySpace alongside other walkgrid substrates (FractalSpace, ErosionSpace, WaveInterferenceSpace); contrasts with flat SineSpace; used as the noise_space map substrate
identities.truth: a noise landscape is the simplest possible proof that order and randomness are not opposites — every point in this terrain is deterministically computed yet no two regions feel the same

identities.essence: animated topological chaos — a walkable surface whose heights breathe with noise
identities.desire: feel the floor breathe; walk a terrain whose elevation is renegotiated every frame
identities.critical_parameter: chaos_level — amplifies how much the surface deviates from its initial heights
identities.triggers: each animation tick re-samples heights according to AnimationType (WAVE/RIPPLE/RANDOM_WALK/CHAOTIC)
identities.emerges: a VR-walkable random landscape that updates collision at collision_update_interval to keep frame rate
identities.needs: chaos slider [has]; animation type picker [has]; seed reseed button [missing]
identities.relationships: subclass of TopologySpace; sibling of SineSpace (deterministic) and other walkgrid topologies
identities.truth: A floor is a contract; a chaotic floor is a question. Walking it is research — randomness underfoot teaches what stability means.

identities.essence: a walkable floor sculpted as a 2D sine surface — sin(x)*cos(z) under the feet
identities.desire: stand on the equation, walk the periodicity, feel resolution and amplitude as physical
identities.critical_parameter: wave_frequency — controls the ridge spacing across the walkable resolution grid
identities.triggers: generate_space() samples heights at every (x,z) of the resolution grid, builds mesh and trimesh collision
identities.emerges: a smooth metallic surveillance-aesthetic floor whose ridges and troughs invite directional walking
identities.needs: frequency slider [missing]; amplitude slider [missing]; phase X/Z dials [missing]
identities.relationships: subclass of TopologySpace; sibling of RandomSpace (chaotic, animated) — they mark the deterministic and stochastic poles of walkable topology
identities.truth: A floor that obeys an equation is not less random than one that doesn't — it is randomness collapsed to its rule, made walkable.

identities.essence: three labeled CSGCylinder3D axes (X=red, Y=green, Z=blue) assembled into a pickable coordinate reference object that the player can hold in their hand
identities.desire: to hold space in your hand — to pick up the XYZ gadget and reorient it until you understand that X, Y, and Z are directions relative to you, not absolute truths about the world
identities.critical_parameter: initial_scale — at 3.2x the gadget is large enough to read labels comfortably in VR; at 1.0 it would be too small to hold and read simultaneously
identities.triggers: grabbing the object lets the player physically rotate it, embodying the relationship between coordinate axes; the axes' emission glow makes them readable in dark VR environments
identities.emerges: students consistently discover that "X goes right" is only true when you're looking in the default direction — rotating the gadget breaks this assumption and makes coordinates genuinely spatial rather than notational
identities.needs: colored axis cylinders [has]; pickup physics [has via grab_sphere]; Label3D axis labels [has]; no slider or button controls [has none needed]
identities.relationships: appears in Tutorial_Single (first VR object encounter), Tutorial_Row, Tutorial_2D_Build (coordinate reference throughout array tutorial); contrasts with basis_vectors_rig (mathematical vs intuitive representation)
identities.truth: coordinate systems are conventions about shared directions, not properties of space itself — the XYZ gadget makes this visible by being rotatable

identities.essence: Procedural botanical generator — stem, leaves, sepals, petals, stamens, pistil assembled in correct anatomical order
identities.desire: To make flower form a parameter space rather than a fixed mesh, so morphology becomes legible as decisions
identities.critical_parameter: phyllotaxis_angle and inflorescence_pattern — they organize how parts arrange in space
identities.triggers: Changing petal_count produces tulip→daisy→chrysanthemum; switching inflorescence shifts single bloom to raceme to umbel
identities.emerges: Eight inflorescence patterns and six flower forms compose a small botanical vocabulary that yields infinite plausible flowers
identities.needs: configure() API [has], rebuild on parameter change [has], grid wrapper for VR [has via BotanicalFlowerArtifact]
identities.relationships: Core engine consumed by botanical_flower (artifact wrapper), evolving_flowers (phenotype), Flower_* maps in flowers sequence
identities.truth: A flower is the parameter set that decided how to repeat — petals are the trace of phyllotaxis, not the flower itself.

identities.essence: a convex deltahedron that unfolds from its flat net — Cauchy's theorem guarantees rigidity when assembled
identities.desire: a creature whose genome IS its net topology — tetrahedron, octahedron, icosahedron are species
identities.critical_parameter: fold_amount — 0.0 is flat net (vulnerable), 1.0 is assembled solid (rigid, strong)
identities.triggers: fold_amount drives all vertex positions simultaneously — single DOF via lerp between flat and 3D
identities.emerges: structural integrity increases with fold_amount; partially folded = partially vulnerable
identities.needs: PrimitiveMeshBuilder [reuse]; GridMaterialFactory [reuse]; existing polyhedra vertex data [reuse]
identities.relationships: replaces hand-placed segments with mathematically grounded nets; each deltahedron is a species
identities.truth: triangles can't deform. A closed convex deltahedron can't flex. The net IS the genome.

identities.essence: five octahedra in a row — fold_amount 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0 — the complete fold progression
identities.desire: see the entire lifecycle at once — flat net to rigid diamond in five frozen steps
identities.critical_parameter: spacing between stages shows the fold as a continuous transformation
identities.truth: one variable, five snapshots, the whole story.

identities.essence: a triangle strip coiled in a Fibonacci spiral unfolds into a sine-wave snake
identities.desire: golden ratio geometry becoming locomotion — the spiral IS the resting pose, the wave IS the motion
identities.critical_parameter: fold_amount — 0.0 is tight Fibonacci spiral, 1.0 is straight sine-wave snake
identities.triggers: vertices interpolate between spiral positions and sine-wave positions
identities.emerges: the snake slithers by phase-shifting the sine wave along its body

identities.essence: octahedron = 6 vertices, 12 edges, 8 faces — dual of the cube, all faces equilateral triangles
identities.desire: learner places 6 floating points and discovers the shape that emerges from this particular arrangement
identities.critical_parameter: 6 snap target positions — form a regular octahedron at ±1 on each axis

identities.relationships: extends SnapPointPuzzleBase; sibling to snap_tetrahedron_puzzle; grab_octahedron is its held version

identities.essence: square pyramid = 5 vertices, 8 edges, 5 faces (1 square + 4 triangles) — non-Platonic mixed solid
identities.desire: learner places 5 points and observes how a square base plus apex forces triangular sides
identities.critical_parameter: 5 snap target positions — 4 corners of a square base plus 1 apex above center
identities.triggers: snapping all 5 snap points to their targets → puzzle complete signal fires

identities.relationships: extends SnapPointPuzzleBase; sibling to snap_tetrahedron_puzzle; pyramid.gd is its static version

identities.essence: tetrahedron = 4 vertices, 6 edges, 4 triangular faces — the minimal 3D solid
identities.desire: learner constructs the simplest possible polyhedron from 4 floating snap points
identities.critical_parameter: 4 snap target positions — form the unique convex hull of 4 non-coplanar points
identities.triggers: snapping all 4 snap points to their targets → puzzle complete signal fires
identities.emerges: the tetrahedron as the 3D analog of the triangle — irreducible, minimum faces for enclosure
identities.needs: [missing VR controls besides snapping — no label or slider]
identities.relationships: extends SnapPointPuzzleBase; logical successor to triangle_line_puzzle in 3D
identities.truth: you cannot enclose volume with fewer than 4 faces — the tetrahedron is the minimum

identities.essence: StaticBody3D sphere on collision layer 21 — when a laser pointer ray hits it, the sphere disappears and fires 30 particle instances outward with procedurally-synthesized explosion audio (noise burst + 60Hz rumble, 0.3s)
identities.desire: to give the learner a small violent feedback loop — point the laser, make the sphere vanish; it rewards precision with a little chaos and teaches that the laser is a tool that transforms things
identities.critical_parameter: explosion_particle_count (30) — more particles feel more satisfying but are heavier; the audio synthesis uses randf() noise with exponential decay, so every explosion sounds slightly different
identities.triggers: StaticBody3D collision layer 21 catches the laser raycast; trigger_explosion() spawns particles in random outward directions, plays audio, then hides the sphere; particles queue_free after explosion_lifetime
identities.emerges: the sphere resets after the explosion (it is a static teaching object, not a consumable) — the reset reveals that destruction here is a demonstration, not a consequence
identities.needs: VR laser pointer interaction [has via StaticBody3D layer 21]; explosion particles [has]; explosion audio [has]; respawn delay for reset [missing — appears to hide permanently after explosion]
identities.relationships: placed in Point_Lines alongside laser_measure — both are objects that the laser interacts with, but one measures and one destroys; the contrast makes the laser feel like a tool with different modes
identities.truth: a laser pointer is not a cursor — it is a ray that either measures distance or triggers a reaction; the sphere teaches the second possibility

identities.essence: Concentric Pride-color rings on a cylindrical target — hit registration with rippling response and point scoring
identities.desire: To turn the target — usually a violent object — into a celebratory and responsive surface; aim becomes greeting
identities.critical_parameter: ring count and points_per_hit — they decide how the target reads as flag and as game
identities.triggers: Hits anywhere produce ripple feedback; ring stacking reads as Pride flag at rest, target face under aim
identities.emerges: The same geometry is two cultural objects depending on intent — flag when still, target when sighted

identities.relationships: Anchor object in forces/Combat_Arena map alongside gravity_gun and vector_normalize_demo
identities.truth: A target does not have an inside and an outside — it has a surface that records intentions arriving from elsewhere.

identities.essence: TorusMesh(rings, ring_segments, inner_radius, outer_radius) — a circle revolved around an axis
identities.desire: learner understands the torus as a product of two circles — one for the path, one for the tube
identities.critical_parameter: ring_segments — tube cross-section resolution; at 4 it looks square, at 32 it looks round
identities.triggers: grid config syntax (torus_radials_rings#config:16:8) or apply_grid_config() call at runtime

identities.relationships: used in combine_portals and diamondtoruscollection; shares config pattern with capsule
identities.truth: the torus is topologically distinct from the sphere — its genus is 1, meaning it has exactly one hole

identities.essence: constrained_translation — move only on allowed axis; sequential constraints: first UP, then SIDEWAYS
identities.desire: learner physically discovers that translation is axis-specific — the door will not open any other way
identities.critical_parameter: the axis sequence constraint — UP must complete before SIDEWAYS unlocks

identities.needs: [has two grabbable door knobs [has], missing visual axis indicator showing current allowed direction]
identities.relationships: precursor to axis_translation_cube; demonstrates constrained translation before the animated version
identities.truth: a translation requires both a direction and a magnitude — constraint is what makes it meaningful

identities.essence: triangle(elevated) + cylinder(stick) — a triangle raised on a pole like a parasol
identities.desire: to make triangles visible from across the room — a flag, a marker, an invitation
identities.critical_parameter: stick_height / triangle_scale — the parasol must read as "triangle on a stick" instantly
identities.triggers: placed in map, visible from spawn — draws the eye upward to the triangle surface
identities.emerges: the triangle becomes architectural — not just a shape but a structure, a shelter, a sign

identities.relationships: child of triangle.gd concept; placed in Point_Triangle map; one per map as landmark
