identities.essence: spectrum(t) = sum(A_n * sin(n * f * t)) -- sound built by stacking sine harmonics
identities.desire: oscillator pillars rise in harmonic series, each partial adding timbre to a growing chord
identities.critical_parameter: harmonic_count -- number of partials stacked; theme profiles cycle queer/sci_fi/cyberpunk/epic
identities.triggers: theme_timer cycles through 4 profiles, each reshaping fundamental frequency, harmonic weights, and vibrato
identities.emerges: rich timbral color from pure sine waves -- bell, choir, organ from arithmetic frequency ratios
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; real-time sample-level synthesis [has]; VR slider controls [missing]
identities.relationships: paired with subtractive_synthesis (building up vs sculpting down); feeds fm_synthesis
identities.truth: every complex sound is a sum of simple oscillations -- order produces richness, not randomness.

identities.essence: carrier(t) = sin(2pi*fc*t + I*sin(2pi*fm*t)) -- one oscillator bending another from inside
identities.desire: metallic bells and electric pianos cascade from two sine waves interfering at audio rate
identities.critical_parameter: modulation_index -- small changes cascade into dense harmonic spectra; ratio sets carrier:modulator
identities.triggers: theme profiles cycle carrier frequency, ratio, index depth, feedback amount, and harmonic mix
identities.emerges: sounds that analog circuits cannot produce -- infinite sidebands from two simple oscillators
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; carrier/modulator phase tracking [has]; feedback path [has]; VR controls [missing]
identities.relationships: extends additive/subtractive by replacing addition with interference; Chowning DX7 legacy
identities.truth: modulation is not addition -- it is mutual distortion, producing harmonics neither source contains alone.

identities.essence: next_note = markov_chain[current_note] -- algorithmic composition via probabilistic note selection
identities.desire: melody that writes itself -- Markov chains choosing pitch, rhythm following tempo, scales shifting
identities.critical_parameter: markov_chain transition probabilities -- which note follows which; tempo and scale set the frame
identities.triggers: beat_timer fires notes per BPM; theme profiles reshape scale, tempo, vibrato, bass probability
identities.emerges: music between noise and loops -- pattern almost holds, repetition almost breaks
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; Markov chain state [has]; polyphonic note management [has]; VR controls [missing]
identities.relationships: synthesis of all prior audio artifacts; Markov concept shared with grammar_markov hazard
identities.truth: if a system produces music without intent, who is the musician? The rules, the randomness, or the listener?

identities.essence: output(t) = sum(grain(t_i, size, pitch, envelope)) -- thousands of micro-fragments into texture
identities.desire: a cloud of sonic particles -- each grain too short to hear alone, together forming atmosphere
identities.critical_parameter: grain_density / grain_size -- how many overlap and how long each lives; scatter randomizes
identities.triggers: theme profiles reshape density, pitch, scatter, pan spread; grains spawn continuously
identities.emerges: texture without waveform -- statistical accumulation produces sound no oscillator generates
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; per-grain envelope and phase [has]; pad synthesis layer [has]; VR controls [missing]
identities.relationships: micro-counterpart to additive (grains vs harmonics); parallels particle systems
identities.truth: enough fragments of a thing become the thing -- or something it never was. Identity through multiplicity.

identities.essence: perception = transform(signal, cochlea, brain) -- the gap between pressure wave and heard sound
identities.desire: masking, beating, binaural offsets -- auditory illusions revealing how hearing constructs reality
identities.critical_parameter: masker_frequency / probe_offset -- where one tone renders another inaudible
identities.triggers: theme profiles reshape masker frequency, probe timing, binaural offset, modulation depth
identities.emerges: perception is not reception but generation -- the ear performs its own Fourier transform
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; masker/probe envelope system [has]; binaural offset [has]; VR controls [missing]
identities.relationships: capstone of proceduralaudio -- all synthesis lands between waveform and listener
identities.truth: the instrument is the ear -- every synthesis decision is judged by what the listener constructs.

identities.essence: output(t) = filter(oscillator(t), cutoff, resonance) -- sculpting timbre by removing frequencies
identities.desire: a bright sawtooth darkens as the filter sweeps down, resonance peaks at the cutoff edge
identities.critical_parameter: filter_frequency / filter_resonance -- where removal happens and how much it feeds back
identities.triggers: theme cycles reshape base frequency, filter drive, LFO rate; filter type rotates low/high/band/notch
identities.emerges: identity through subtraction -- the Minimoog sound comes from what the filter withholds
identities.needs: AudioStreamGenerator [has]; state-variable filter [has]; LFO modulation [has]; VR controls [missing]
identities.relationships: complement of additive_synthesis (sculpt vs build); filter concept echoes subtractive sculpture
identities.truth: identity emerges through what gets removed -- the material is always already there.

identities.essence: CSG subtraction along procedural walk paths — random walk, spiral, branch, Perlin, tunnel patterns carving boolean voids
identities.desire: To show that AND, OR, NOT applied to solid geometry produce caves, tunnels, and organic voids from boolean logic
identities.critical_parameter: pattern — which carving strategy (random walk, spiral, branches, Perlin, grid tunnels) shapes the void
identities.triggers: Random walk creates wormholes; spiral creates nautilus cores; branches create root systems; Perlin creates organic caves
identities.emerges: Complex sculptural voids inside solid blocks from boolean subtraction along procedural paths
identities.needs: Auto-generate [has], path visualization [has], seed control [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Synthesis artifact for constraint_solvers sequence. Boolean CSG operations as spatial grammar alongside WFC.
identities.truth: Subtraction is a generative act — what you remove defines the form more than what you leave.

identities.essence: Model Synthesis (Merrell 2007) — 3D voxel generation via overlap constraints from exemplar with coherence search
identities.desire: To grow a cave system from a small example: learn local neighborhoods and synthesize globally coherent output
identities.critical_parameter: overlap_size — how many voxels of context must match; larger = more faithful, slower
identities.triggers: Auto-generate fills the volume; coherence search accelerates by reusing exemplar positions; debug shows internals
identities.emerges: Caves, tunnels, and chambers that look like the exemplar but extend far beyond it
identities.needs: Exemplar generation [has], coherence optimization [has], auto-generate [has], debug mode [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Core artifact in constraint_solvers alongside wfc_dungeon_generator. Model Synthesis is WFC's volumetric cousin.
identities.truth: The cave was never designed — it was constrained into existence, neighborhood by neighborhood.

identities.essence: 3D Wave Function Collapse — entropy-based cell selection collapsing tile superpositions with socket adjacency propagation
identities.desire: To watch a world crystallize from pure possibility: every cell starts as everything, then observation forces a choice
identities.critical_parameter: grid_size — the volume to fill; larger grids produce more complex emergent landscapes but risk contradiction
identities.triggers: Animated generation shows cells collapsing in real time; base terrain seeds the bottom; propagation ripples outward
identities.emerges: Voxel landscapes with grass, dirt, stone, water, sand — all from tile adjacency rules and entropy-minimizing selection
identities.needs: Animated generation [has], socket compatibility [has], base terrain seeding [has], VR walkthrough [missing]
identities.relationships: Paired with wave_function_collapse in constraint_solvers. Uses prototypes from wfc_3d_tiles.
identities.truth: The world does not emerge from randomness — it emerges from the collapse of possibility under constraint.

identities.essence: 2D Wave Function Collapse dungeon generator — room and corridor tiles collapsed via socket adjacency into floor plans
identities.desire: To generate dungeons that feel designed but were never drawn: rooms connect because the rules permit nothing else
identities.critical_parameter: grid_width x grid_height — the dungeon footprint; larger grids produce more complex layouts
identities.triggers: Auto-generate fills the grid on ready; seed control enables reproducible dungeons; max_iterations prevents loops
identities.emerges: Coherent dungeon layouts with rooms, corridors, and props — architecture from tile adjacency rules alone
identities.needs: Tile prototype loading [has], socket rules [has], floor/wall materials [has], auto-generate [has], VR walkthrough [has]
identities.relationships: Dungeon application of WFC in constraint_solvers. Contrasts with BSP dungeon generation (constraint vs division).
identities.truth: A dungeon is not designed — it precipitates from adjacency rules, and the rules never see the whole.

identities.essence: P(next|current) = transition_matrix[current][next] — a memoryless stochastic process: 5 states in a circle, weighted arcs, dice-roll selection animation, stationary distribution convergence
identities.desire: to watch the golden selector bar sweep across probability columns and land on the next state — to see visit frequencies converge to the stationary distribution after enough steps
identities.critical_parameter: transition_matrix — the row-stochastic matrix whose eigenvalue-1 eigenvector determines the long-run frequency of every state, regardless of where the chain starts
identities.triggers: advance_markov_step fires every 1.5s — rolls random value against cumulative probabilities, animates transition arc, updates visit frequency bars and memoryless sequence fading
identities.emerges: the sequence display fades older elements (age * 0.15 opacity decay) to embody the Markov property — past history literally disappears, only the current state glows bright
identities.needs: [missing] no VR slider_horizontal or push_button — no interactive control of step_interval or transition probabilities; relies on .tscn scene tree nodes ($StateSpace, $ProbabilityMatrix, etc.)
identities.relationships: the narrative generation artifact for PatternGeneration_Narrative_Generation; shares probabilistic foundations with randomness sequence; the stationary distribution connects to eigenvalue theory
identities.truth: a Markov chain does not know what it is saying — it does not need to; structure was never about understanding, it was about the weight of what comes next

identities.essence: Markov chain state machine growing a 3D tree — branch, grow, curve, or terminate as probabilistic state transitions
identities.desire: To show that a tree is a random walk through growth states: each branch tip rolls dice to decide its next move
identities.critical_parameter: branch_probability — the chance of forking; low values grow poles, high values grow bushes
identities.triggers: High terminate_probability produces bonsai; high vertical_bias produces columnar; balanced produces naturalistic crown
identities.emerges: Organic branching structure from eight Markov states — the tree shape is its transition matrix made spatial
identities.needs: @tool editor preview [has], animated growth [has], bark/leaf materials [has], regenerate button [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Tree variant of markov_chains in grammar_systems. Contrasts with L-system trees (rule rewriting vs state walking).
identities.truth: A tree does not follow a blueprint — it walks a probability space, and the walk becomes wood.

identities.essence: space colonization algorithm — branches grow toward attractors, each step: find closest attractor, add jitter, extend by growth_distance, mark reached attractors as consumed
identities.desire: to watch a tree grow toward light in real time — branches reaching, splitting, and filling space as attractors guide their path through 3D
identities.critical_parameter: jitter — at 0 the growth is deterministic and straight, at high values branches wander organically, creating the difference between crystal and root
identities.triggers: attractor proximity (< min_branch_distance) kills an attractor and deactivates the branch; pride flag color cycling every 10 seconds shifts the visual palette
identities.emerges: branches competing for the same attractors create natural spacing patterns that resemble real vascular networks without any explicit spacing rule
identities.needs: slider_horizontal [missing]; push_button [missing]; Label3D [missing]
identities.relationships: appears in SoftBodies_Playground_of_Joy bridging soft body play to growth algorithms; connects to reaction_diffusion as another form of pattern-from-process
identities.truth: a tree does not plan its shape — it grows toward what attracts it, and the shape is what remains after all the reaching is done

identities.essence: continuous-growth variant of branching space colonization — branches age, energy decays, attractors regenerate, and the system passes through four growth phases (rapid, steady, flowering, dormant) on a 20-second cycle
identities.desire: to watch a tree that does not stop — growth as ongoing seasonal practice rather than a single reach toward attractors and then stillness
identities.critical_parameter: phase_duration — short cycles produce frantic seasonal churn, long cycles produce slow architectural change; this is what turns the algorithm from snapshot into ecosystem
identities.triggers: phase_timer crossing phase_duration advances current_growth_phase and shifts behavior; branch.age exceeding branch_lifespan triggers is_dying; attractor_timer regenerates attractors at attractor_regeneration_rate
identities.emerges: the same space colonization rule run over time produces succession patterns — early-phase rapid colonization yields to flowering structures yields to dormant skeletons that the next cycle grows around
identities.needs: slider_horizontal [missing], push_button [missing], Label3D [missing]
identities.relationships: extension of branching_growth_algorithm that adds time as a parameter; the primary file shows the algorithm, this one shows the algorithm-as-life-cycle; connects to ecology progression and CritterEntity aging
identities.truth: a tree's shape is the residue of attraction, but a forest's shape is the residue of seasons — you need both rules to see what growth actually means

identities.essence: N walkers carve air from solid voxel grid — biased random walk inward, then upward level by level
identities.desire: to spelunk through a cave that no one designed, knowing every tunnel exists because a random walker happened to step there
identities.critical_parameter: walkers — more walkers create more interconnected passages; fewer create lonely corridors with dead ends
identities.triggers: regenerate() rebuilds from seed; walkers start from four sides, converge at center, then climb — three distinct phases
identities.emerges: the biased-toward-center walk in Phase A creates a natural hub without explicitly coding one; vertical climbing creates multi-story caves
identities.needs: voxel collision [has]; spawn gizmo [has]; VR exploration [has]; seed control slider [missing]
identities.relationships: paired with maze_generation in PG_Caves_Mazes; contrasts random walk (organic) with recursive backtracking (structured)
identities.truth: a cave is not empty space — it is the record of everything that was removed, and the walker's path is the cave's memory

identities.essence: Cellular automaton on a 2D stress grid — cells crack when local stress exceeds threshold, propagating fracture to neighbors
identities.desire: To watch destruction emerge from accumulation: stress builds invisibly, then cracks bloom along paths of least resistance
identities.critical_parameter: CRACK_THRESHOLD — the breaking point; lower values create dense shatter, higher values yield sparse clean fractures
identities.triggers: High propagation rate produces explosive branching; direction bias produces river-like cracks; low threshold fragments everything
identities.emerges: Realistic fracture networks from three cell states and local stress transfer
identities.needs: Per-frame simulation [has], crack mesh visualization [has], seed control [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Growth system in biological_growth alongside slimemold, mushrooms, tree_gen. CA-based like cellular_automata_3d_tree.
identities.truth: A crack does not choose where to go — it reads the stress the material already carries.

identities.essence: population[i].fitness = f(genome) -> select, crossover, mutate, repeat — evolution without a designer
identities.desire: to watch 3D creatures evolve in front of you, generation by generation, toward a fitness goal no individual understands
identities.critical_parameter: mutation_rate — too low and evolution stagnates, too high and good solutions dissolve; 0.3 is the edge of chaos
identities.triggers: auto_evolve ticks generations on a timer; evolve_one_generation allows manual stepping; fitness_function selects the selection pressure
identities.emerges: creatures converge on similar body plans despite random initialization — convergent evolution from pure math
identities.needs: population grid display [has]; fitness labels [has]; auto-evolve timer [has]; VR selection pressure picker [missing]
identities.relationships: opener for proceduralgeneration sequence; contrasts with space_colonization_algorithm (evolution vs growth); genome_type spans primitives to L-systems
identities.truth: evolution does not design — it accumulates accidents that happen to survive

identities.essence: Life-like CA with forced quad/octant/rotational symmetry — pattern = rule + mirror
identities.desire: To tile the floor with living kaleidoscope patterns that breathe between order and dissolution
identities.critical_parameter: symmetry_type — quad, eight-way, or rotational mirror fundamentally changes the visual grammar
identities.triggers: Switching symmetry mode transforms the same rules into radically different visual languages
identities.emerges: Mandala-like forms from stochastic birth/death plus symmetry enforcement — no mandala was coded
identities.needs: VR symmetry selector [missing], birth/death probability sliders [missing], Label3D [has]
identities.relationships: Contrasts with persian_rug (deterministic symmetry vs stochastic). Feeds into CA_GameOfLife.
identities.truth: Symmetry is not decoration — it is a second rule system layered on the first.

identities.essence: P(x,z) = noise(x,z) > threshold → spawn — noise-driven spatial Poisson process
identities.desire: wander through a procedural mushroom meadow where fairy rings and clusters emerge from noise
identities.critical_parameter: mushroom_density — controls expected count per unit area; interacts with FastNoiseLite clearing threshold
identities.triggers: generate_mushroom_positions() uses noise to create natural clearings; create_mushroom_patterns() adds fairy rings and clusters
identities.emerges: fairy rings form perfect circles of identical species — order self-organizing within the random field

identities.relationships: feeds Random_Mushrooms map alongside random_number_book_page_collection; contrasts with pheromone_terrain (static vs dynamic growth)
identities.truth: A mushroom meadow is randomness that has found a niche — noise filtered through ecology.

identities.essence: P(occupied) = threshold -> CA flow propagation from top to bottom — does the random lattice percolate?
identities.desire: to stand inside a 3D lattice and watch pink flow seep through white cubes, hoping it reaches the bottom before paths run out
identities.critical_parameter: PERCOLATION_THRESHOLD (0.4) — the probability that defines whether the system connects or fragments; near p_c the outcome is uncertain
identities.triggers: _process ticks the CA every frame; flow propagates through 6-connected neighbors; collision removed from flowing cubes so player can walk through the network
identities.emerges: at the critical threshold, the percolating cluster forms a fractal — neither filling the space nor vanishing, but threading through it
identities.needs: per-cube collision [has]; flow visualization [has]; real-time CA [has]; VR threshold slider [missing]; Label3D [missing]
identities.relationships: bridges cellularautomata sequence to proceduralgeneration; contrasts with caverandomwalk (random walk vs random lattice); teaches phase transitions
identities.truth: connectivity is not gradual — below the threshold nothing connects, above it everything does, and at the threshold the system decides

identities.essence: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion on GPU via ping-pong SubViewport rendering — feed_rate and kill_rate parameters select pattern regimes (coral, mitosis, spots, maze, waves)
identities.desire: to watch Turing patterns bloom on a quad in front of you — spots splitting, stripes forming, mazes growing — all from two chemicals diffusing at different speeds
identities.critical_parameter: feed_rate / kill_rate pair — together they select the pattern regime; tiny changes (0.001) cross phase boundaries between spots and stripes
identities.triggers: preset cycling (KEY_LEFT/RIGHT) loads predefined feed/kill pairs; KEY_SPACE drops a new seed point; KEY_R resets the simulation to uniform state
identities.emerges: seed placement geometry determines the initial symmetry which the reaction-diffusion dynamics then break or amplify — same parameters, different seeds, different patterns
identities.needs: slider_horizontal [missing]; push_button [missing]; Label3D [has] (preset label)
identities.relationships: GPU shader complement to turing_pattern_generator's CPU simulation; absorbed into softbodies sequence from morphogenesis
identities.truth: Turing's last paper proved that two diffusing chemicals can create pattern from homogeneity — no blueprint needed, only differential diffusion

identities.essence: dA/dt = D_a*nabla^2(A) - A*B^2 + f*(1-A); dB/dt = D_b*nabla^2(B) + A*B^2 - (k+f)*B
identities.desire: watch two chemicals chase each other into coral, mitosis, mazes — Turing's morphogenesis alive
identities.critical_parameter: feed_rate / kill_rate ratio — tiny changes cross phase boundaries between spots, stripes, and chaos
identities.triggers: preset auto-cycle switches Gray-Scott parameters every 30s; random seeds nucleate new pattern islands
identities.emerges: self-organizing spatial patterns from uniform initial conditions — structure from nothing but diffusion and reaction
identities.needs: VR parameter controls [missing], preset selection buttons [missing], touch-to-seed interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: unlocks edge_core understanding; depends on diffusion/laplacian concepts; contrasts ordered_grid (imposed order vs emergent order)
identities.truth: pattern does not require a planner — two diffusing chemicals and a nonlinear reaction are sufficient for morphogenesis

identities.essence: a 128×128 Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation displayed on a 3D mesh plane — two chemical species U and V diffuse at different rates, react, and self-organize into spots, stripes, and branching coral-like patterns from uniform random noise
identities.desire: to show that pattern is a property of dynamics, not of design — the spots and stripes are not drawn; they are consequences of how two competing processes balance across a field
identities.critical_parameter: feed/kill ratio — small changes cross phase boundaries, switching the system from spots to stripes to mazes to corals; different regions of (feed, kill) parameter space are literally different morphological regimes
identities.triggers: _ready initializes U/V arrays, creates ImageTexture on a flat MeshInstance3D, starts movement_timer; each tick runs Laplacian convolution + Gray-Scott reaction term on every cell, then pushes the result to the texture
identities.emerges: the simulation is sensitive to initial conditions — same feed/kill with different random seeds produces morphologically identical but spatially unique patterns; the "species" is the parameter pair, not the seed
identities.needs: VR controls for live feed/kill parameter tuning [missing — currently export vars only]; apply_grid_config [missing]
identities.relationships: turing_pattern_generator also implements Gray-Scott but with VR controls; queer_morphology_specimen grows morphological forms using different rules; all three appear in the morphogenesis "Pattern from Noise" map
identities.truth: you don't need a blueprint — the pattern that looks designed emerges from two numbers: how fast each chemical diffuses relative to the other; Turing's morphogenesis is not a metaphor, it is a mechanism

identities.essence: Physarum-inspired viscous tubes and pools — organic growth connecting food sources through chemical trail reinforcement
identities.desire: To watch a brainless organism solve optimization: pools form at nodes, tubes connect them, networks self-organize
identities.critical_parameter: viscosity — controls how thick and slow the slime behaves; high produces cohesive tubes, low produces runny spreading
identities.triggers: More pools produce denser networks; high glossiness produces liquid glass; animation_speed controls growth tempo
identities.emerges: Transport networks rivaling engineered infrastructure from local chemical sensing — no brain, no plan, just trails
identities.needs: Noise-based deformation [has], subsurface scattering [has], bubble animation [has], VR interaction [missing]
identities.relationships: Opening artifact in biological_growth sequence. Inspired by Physarum polycephalum / Atsushi Tero Tokyo rail study.
identities.truth: The slime mold does not solve the maze — it grows through it, and the growth is the solution.

identities.essence: for each leaf_node: find closest attractor, grow segment_length toward it, kill attractor when reached — space colonization
identities.desire: to watch a vascular network bloom from a single root as branches compete for scattered attractor points in 3D
identities.critical_parameter: kill_distance — the radius at which an attractor is consumed; too small and branches overshoot, too large and the tree is sparse
identities.triggers: regenerate rebuilds entirely; step_growth advances one iteration; toggle_animation switches between instant and animated growth
identities.emerges: natural branch tapering from thickness_decay creates tree-like hierarchy without any explicit tree data structure

identities.relationships: follows GeneticProgramming (evolution vs growth); contrasts with branching_growth_algorithm (attractor-driven vs free branching)
identities.truth: a tree does not know its shape — it only knows which direction has light, and how far to reach before stopping

identities.essence: Proximity-based procedural tree spawner — generates parametric trees around VR camera position with distance culling
identities.desire: To populate a forest that grows around the player: trees appear ahead and vanish behind, infinite generated nature
identities.critical_parameter: generation_distance — the radius within which new trees spawn; controls forest extent around the player
identities.triggers: Walking forward spawns trees ahead; max_trees caps density; min_tree_spacing prevents overlap

identities.essence: VR control panel for sixteen-cell net space — sliders and buttons adjusting size, spacing, hollow, and net pattern
identities.desire: To give hands-on control over a 4D polytope projection: resize, respace, hollow out, cycle net patterns in real time
identities.critical_parameter: pattern cycle — Cross, T-Shape, L-Shape, Zigzag, Spiral — each unfolding 16 tetrahedral cells differently

identities.essence: Desktop UI controller for tessellating portal — sliders for radius, thickness, block size, color, emission, animation

identities.relationships: Controller for tessellating_portal_demo in higher_dimensions. Synthesis of projection, nets, and topology.

identities.essence: Desktop UI controller for tesseract net space — net type, dimensions, cube size, spacing, color, wireframe, hollow toggles
identities.desire: To unfold a 4D hypercube into walkable 3D rooms and let players choose which of 261 possible nets to explore

identities.essence: 4D hypercube tessellation projected into a walkable 3D tunnel — perspective, stereographic, and orthographic projections

identities.triggers: Changing projection_type switches views; w animation creates breathing geometry; edge colors shift with 4D depth
identities.emerges: Architecture that cannot exist in 3D — nested cubes, self-intersecting edges, cells passing through each other
